technical_and_interpretive_guards: If an observed sample has zero non-ileal epithelial cells, the primary composition metric is non-evaluable. Pseudocount0.5 smooths a measured zero CT numerator only; it does not manufacture a denominator.
Report site pairs and patients evaluable for each axis. Any composition-versus-state comparison uses the joint evaluable patient/site subset.
Do not compare axes by one significant and one nonsignificant result. Use jointly evaluable data, same-scale two-group decomposition contributions, effect estimates and uncertainty.
The non-CT epithelial within-group term contains changes among heterogeneous non-CT substates and is not a pure intracellular-regulation term.
Exact label permutation assumes exchangeability and cannot remove the chemistry/outcome imbalance; v3.1-only sensitivity remains mandatory.
